sections.heading: WHY JOIN THE NAPSGEAR AFFILIATE PROGRAM?
paras: With our NapsGear Commission Program, your referral is truly "yours"! Your referrals will be recognized every time they access our website! This means that if your referral does not buy anything the first time they visit and register with our site you can still earn commissions up to 6 months later. It will work even if customer buys a new computer or deletes all types of cookies from their computer. Our system tracks referrals and pays top commissions for every sale you send our way.

Customers are identified using their email and IP address. After your customer registers with us, NapsGear will link the customer with your affiliate account. The visitors IP is logged and a cookie is placed in their browser for 6 months. All orders placed by this customer will be assigned to your affiliate for 6 months. If the customer clicks on another affiliate banner, they will still be assigned commission to your affiliate account.
Every 6 months, affiliates are provided with brand new affiliate links to encourage your repeat customers and commissions!

NapsGear offer a wide variety of products and competitive prices. NapsGear major success can be reduced to our extremely high conversion rates; high conversion rates mean most visitors to our site place at least one order!

We regularly test our shopping experience to improve the NapsGear experience. As technology changes, we are striving to keep up and keep things fun for our users! We also listen to our customers when they provide feedback.
Are you ready?! Are you excited?! You can start referring business and earn commissions today!

sections.heading: AFFILIATE PROGRAM - FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
paras: Currently we offer bitcoin, litecoin, Western Union and MoneyGram payments. Western Union and Moneygram payments are subject to transaction fees and are payable in US Dollars or Euros. If your balance has not met that requirement by the end of the month, the balance will roll over to the next month until it meets the required amount.
You may request an early withdrawal at any time. All you need to do is send an email to our Billing Department requesting the amount you wish to be paid (Minimum is $100).

Specially coded banners, button and text links are provided to you through the NapsGear affiliate program. These links register your unique account with napsgear.org every time a visitor to your site clicks your link. If that customer makes a purchase at napsgear.org, the commission is automatically credited to your account for every purchase they make for 6 months.

Even if your referral does not buy anything the first time they visit and register with our site, you can still earn commissions up to 6 months later. Every 6 months, affiliate link expire and a brand new link is provided. This is to encourage your repeat business!
